name: deforay/spirdt
description: SPI-RDT — Stepwise Process for Improving the Quality of Rapid Diagnostic Testing: site assessment platform

scripts-descriptions.template:build: Regenerate the canonical SPI-RDT template from resources/source/. Re-run after the instrument is revised rather than hand-editing the JSON.
scripts-descriptions.template:validate: Validate every template in the repository against the schema, structurally and semantically — the shipped ones in resources/templates/ and the synthetic ones behind the scoring fixtures. Pass a path to check one.
scripts-descriptions.setup: First-run setup: prerequisites, .env, dependencies, database, migrations, verification. Idempotent. --reset drops every table first (refuses on production).
scripts-descriptions.app:upgrade: Upgrade an existing install: backup, sync code, migrate unconditionally, verify. Aborts if the backup fails. Named app:upgrade, not upgrade, because Composer treats 'upgrade' as its own alias for 'update' and silently skips a script of that name — so 'composer upgrade' would update every dependency instead of upgrading the app.
scripts-descriptions.refresh: Pull the latest code and bring the checkout back to runnable. Runs composer install only when composer.lock changed, and migrations only when migrations/ changed. Supports --status, --dry-run, --stash, --branch=.
scripts-descriptions.preflight: Check this machine can run the app: PHP version, extensions, .env, writable paths, DB reachability. Works the same inside Docker and on a bare host.
scripts-descriptions.serve: Run the API on PHP's built-in server (no Docker). Dev only. Pass a port or host:port.
scripts-descriptions.migrate: Apply pending schema migrations from migrations/. Supports --status, --dry-run, --verbose.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Unit suite only — no DB, fast. Where the scoring-engine fixtures run.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Integration suite — hits the test DB.
scripts-descriptions.test:feature: Feature suite — full HTTP request/response through the Slim stack. Cross-tenant isolation tests live here.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Static analysis. Fails CI on any error not in phpstan-baseline.neon.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan:baseline: Regenerate the baseline to silence current errors. Use after a refactor, not to dodge new ones.
scripts-descriptions.cs:check: Report style violations without writing. What CI runs.
scripts-descriptions.post-update: Post-deploy hook: run pending migrations after composer install.
scripts-descriptions.db:backup: Backup via amitdugar/db-tools (zstd), honouring db-tools.php for output dir and retention. --no-encrypt because db-tools currently writes no archive at all when an encryption password is supplied. db-tools also provides restore/verify/pitr — see: vendor/bin/db-tools list
scripts-descriptions.db:collation: Normalise every table to the server-default utf8mb4 collation. Idempotent.
